messages:
nina: moving a few boxes tonight and want a tiny ritual ~ a 20min "tea & breathe" watch rec + a 6-song 'pack reset' playlist. cozy, non-plot-heavy please :tea:
tyrese: watch: 'Chef's Table' short food intros? each segment is ~20m and very soothing. if you want fiction: try 'Someone Great' short-ish but might be a bit sappy.
hannah: for true 20m: try the Black Mirror short '15 Million Credits' wait no that's wrong. haha. better: a short film "The Bigger Picture" (animation) ~12min and oddly tender. perfect tea break.
liam: playlist (6 songs) for resetting between stacks: 1) Feist - 'Mushaboom' 2) Blood Orange - 'You're Not Good Enough' (soft) 3) Jose Gonze1lez - 'Crosses' 4) Agnes Obel - 'Riverside' 5) Khruangbin - 'Dern Kala' 6) Sufjan Stevens - 'Should Have Known Better' -> ~23min total.
hannah: if you need instrumental-only variant: swap #2+#6 for Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds tracks. keeps the vibe non-distracting.
tyrese: playlist-bot: can you make a quick public mini playlist called 'nina-pack-reset'? @playlist-bot
playlist-bot: Created playlist "nina-pack-reset"  6 tracks  23m total. Link: https://music.internal/playlists/nina-pack-reset
nina: perfect!! also plant-sitter question: anyone want a fern for the weekend in exchange for 3 cinnamon rolls? :seedling::cinnamon_roll:
liam: I volunteer for the fern (and one cinnamon roll)  will bring a mug and help stack boxes.
hannah: saving "Bigger Picture" to my watchlist and the playlist to my commute. tiny rituals are underrated.
tyrese: pro tip: set a kitchen timer for 18 minutes, watch the short, brew a new cup, then finish the last box with the reset song. ritual complete :ok_hand:
nina: you all are amazing. thanks  will bring a plant-care cheat-sheet and maybe an extra roll. pics once the fern is nestled in its new box :camera_with_flash:
